title: Animated Buckets
description: This texture pack changes the textures of all buckets to animated
body:
This texture pack change the textures of all buckets to animated texture.


![Buckets Static (milk bucket is missing)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/574680bf3c51da5c49e43bdb894bb428787da05a.png)


Contains:
- Water Bucket
- Axolotl Bucket
- All fishes Buckets
- Lava Bucket
- Milk Bucket
- Powder Snow Bucket
- and Pufferfish Bucket
The texture pack doesn't change any other textures!![Buckets Static (milk bucket is missing)]
